# Lattice | Product Overview

Lattice is an AI-driven talent and performance platform covering performance, objectives, participation, growth and remuneration. The core of the product is to create a unified workspace around staff, recruitment, pay/leave time or talent management, reducing fragmentation tools and manual maintenance.
